resolved_input_artifacts.image_crop_data_locator_for_later_traini: not resolved by this amendment -- the reconstructed q-parquet carries candidate_id/source_artifact_identity only (sufficient for q-matched MEMBERSHIP selection); the actual image/crop bytes referenced by each candidate_id live under the frozen Flow-1 C6 package artifacts on the GPU host and were not required for, and are out of scope of, this dry-run membership/feasibility amendment. Resolving them is a prerequisite for E8 TRAINING (not attempted in this task) and is deferred to the (not-yet-written) E8 selector/training implementation.

per_sample_q_table.note: every row has historical_passed=True AND historical_selected=True -- this table is already the FINAL SELECTED 1024/arm bank (512 physics + 512 gpat), not a broader quality-gate-pass superset; 'accepted' for this frozen population therefore coincides exactly with 'selected'
per_sample_q_table.sample_id_field: candidate_id (used as the E8 stable-hash sample_id)

resolved_input_artifacts.quality_gate_config_filename_note: three quality_gate_m8*.yaml files exist (unversioned, _v2, _v3); E0's own config_binding_status='NEEDS_CONFIRMATION' flag on which produced quality_threshold_identity=8fa26486... was never resolved anywhere in persisted E2 artifacts. Per this amendment's own instruction, this filename ambiguity alone does not block E8: the effective threshold identity (8fa26486...) and profile semantics (NOMINAL) are uniquely bound, cryptographically identified, and reproducible from C6_PROFILE_SELECTION_LOCK.json / C6_MATCHED_BANKS.json / the reconstruction lock, independent of which literal filename produced them. No filename was guessed.
